name: Softr
title: softr.io
shortDescription: Softr allows users to create custom business software without any coding knowledge. It integrates with existing data and offers numerous templates to customize applications for various workflows. Users can build databases, manage permissions, and even turn web apps into mobile versions quickly. Ideal for businesses looking to streamline operations and reduce reliance on costly software solutions.
cons: Limited customization compared to coded solutions
May not handle very complex workflows
